sources.scientific_reference: Chen et al. (2002), Figure 4, pure-binder t=0 solid-curve endpoints; supplied homogeneous_model_paper.pdf.
sources.status: Arrhenius-only pure-binder calibration to Chen Figure 4 model curves; not experimental material measurements. q=500 and all AP-containing rates are excluded from fitting.
sources.density_cp_conductivity: All constituent density, heat capacity and conductivity values remain exactly at validation_homogeneous_chen2002/binder_q66_calibration/fixed_properties.json; none are fitted.
sources.heat_release: Fixed baseline heats: binder -66 cal/g and AP -100 cal/g. Heat applied once during phase change with frozen gas chemistry; neither heat is fitted.
sources.temperature: T0=300 K retained from the existing validation workflow.
sources.mixing: Pure constituent properties. AP unchanged; only pure binder is calibrated.
sources.kinetics: Only binder A and E/R fitted to q=200 and 1000 pure-binder endpoints; AP kinetics unchanged. Generator converts physical A to the local phase-field rate multiplier.
sources.calibration: Two endpoint Arrhenius fit using temperatures from the fixed thermal balance; simulation/analytic-rate correction. q=500 held out. This conditional effective fit is not a physical-property validation.
